description: Get Pending Purchase Numbers. Part of the Pending Numbers APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 5. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: createdAt. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

pendingItems.description: Pending items query parameter. Default: false. Optional.
